newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Cenbank says will hold real miniband Friday.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Cenbank says will hold real miniband Friday.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank said it intends to maintain unchanged throughout Friday its real-dollar miniband of 1.016-1.021 reais to the dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market.
"The Central Bank's intention is to hold auctions without alterations (of the miniband) today," a bank spokesman said.

The decision had been taken "to avoid speculation on the market and volatility" on the last day of the month, when the closing dollar price is used for the liquidation of September contracts on the futures market, he said.
On Thursday morning the Central Bank surprised markets by lowering its real-dollar miniband by 0.05 percent, less than the expected 0.1 percent.
On Thursday afternoon the Central Bank weakened the miniband by a further 0.05 percent.
